Messages.Author: George Tran
Messages.Body:
In the VTes manual, under the section called "Steal Blood" it mentions
that when a vampire is reduced to zero due to steal blood, it is burnt.
My group noticed this was in the "Basic" section but was never
reiterated in the Advanced rules. Would anyone have any comments on
this? Is this how you guys play?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:

CORRECTIONS TO THE V:TES RULEBOOK

Section 21, Advanced combat/check damage
In the advanced game, if a vampire steals more blood from a vampire
than it has blood to give, do not burn the second vampire. Simply transfer
all of its blood to the first vampire.

Messages.Author: Alec Chang
Messages.Body:
In article <31E269...@symantec.com>, gt...@symantec.com says...

>
>In the VTes manual, under the section called "Steal Blood" it mentions
>that when a vampire is reduced to zero due to steal blood, it is burnt.
>My group noticed this was in the "Basic" section but was never
>reiterated in the Advanced rules. Would anyone have any comments on
>this? Is this how you guys play?
>

>Thanks.
This is NOT how one plays in the real game of Jyhad/V:tES. Personally, I
think that the basic rules are almost a disservice to players by adding
in all kinds of simplistic and just wrong variations on the rules of the
game which tend to just confuse people later. Unless something is
specifically stated in the Advanced('Real') rules, do not assume that it
carries over from basic, unless it's something blatantly obvious, like
the fact that tapped vampires cannot usually play reaction cards.

Anyway, You might be able to tell from my reaction that I almost spewed
the first time I saw those 'basic' rules. WotC could have done so much
better. (Of course, they were less confusing than the first rulebooks
<Shudder>).

Alec Chang

Messages.Body:

> In the VTes manual, under the section called "Steal Blood" it mentions

> My group noticed this was in the "Basic" section but was never
> reiterated in the Advanced rules. Would anyone have any comments on

Very few people play the Basic Game, for IMHO it brings much more
problems than simplifications.
As for stealing all the blood burning the vamp, I must say no, I
do not play with that rule. It is quite unbalanced, not to mention
illegal (?) in the standard game, from what I've heard. I'm not sure about
this, though.

Hope this helps.
